title: Drivetrain and unresolved problem reports
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly describe drivetrain-related faults or other problems that persist, reappear, or remain unresolved, with only isolated mention of trouble-free ownership.

positive.summary: One positive review says the car has had no problems so far.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on ongoing drivetrain faults, repeated warning messages, unresolved repairs, and a few loosely related complaints such as screen usability and headroom.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention drivetrain warnings or lack of a solution without enough context to confirm the overall sentiment.

signal_notes.interpretation: The GB segment is flagged for a high negative-or-mixed share within this topic, but the comparison group is too small to support a stronger comparison.

limitations: This topic cluster is somewhat mixed, because several examples refer to generic 'problems' or unrelated issues like touchscreen operation and headroom rather than drivetrain alone.
The sample examples are limited, so they do not show enough detail to separate confirmed drivetrain failures from broader ownership issues in every case.
Samples are stratified and not representative, so these reviews should not be used to estimate defect rates or prevalence beyond this topic sample.
